payload.expected_mechanism: A Writer-skill revision that (1) requires enumerating every explicitly stated requirement and example in the issue as a short checklist before editing, (2) requires a minimal local reproduction or direct check of each checklist item against the patched code before finalizing, and (3) on a failed second attempt requires pursuing a different approach, not a minor variation of the first.
payload.hypothesis: All five cycle-7 H0 failures (astropy, sympy, seaborn, pytest, sphinx) failed at official_eval after exactly one real attempt whose patch passed the visible suite; all five are feature/maintenance-type issues whose texts enumerate explicit requirements or expected examples. The resolved cases this round were predominantly bugfix-type. Hypothesis: on feature-type requests the Writer commits to the first plausible interpretation without enumerating and locally verifying each explicitly stated requirement/example from the issue; requiring a requirement checklist plus a local reproduction check before finalizing should improve repair quality on behavior-gap failures. A hypothesis from two source projections, not causal truth.
